description: Audit any Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, or Solana token contract for honeypots, buy/sell taxes, hidden ownership, whale concentration, LP locks, live DEX liquidity depth, and AMM slippage impact for an intended USD order size. On Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon it also simulates a real buy -> sell round trip to measure actual taxes and confirm the token can be sold ($0.01 USDC on Base).

chain.description: Target chain (defaults to 'base' for 0x addresses or 'solana' for Base58)

intendedOrderUsd.description: Intended swap size in USD to estimate AMM pool price impact (default 1000)

tokenAddress.description: 0x-prefixed EVM token contract address or Base58 Solana mint address

name: audit_crypto_token
